verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents a built-in agent platform with MCP tool support, but nothing in the evidence shows agents running autonomously in the background, on a schedule, or from triggers. The only execution mode described in detail, `local-ai chat`, is an interactive shell agent behind a user-controlled approval gate. That is a different capability from background automation, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
